predicates: Require start < end and exact endpoints equal to the explicitly designated body window or intent payload intendedTimeWindow.

A designated intent payload must have PRESCRIPTION_WINDOW/PLANNED_WINDOW or the unique exact versioned interpretation of omitted/UNKNOWN under currentProposedQualifierRules. Reject execution/observation time as intent.

Facet is the requested milestone for the named activity/work specification in this window, not evidence it already happened. Preserve planned/target quantities separately from any historical comparison values.
An event is prohibited by retained v0.1 INTENDED_WINDOW rule. No instant observation, subjectTime.at, or already produced result/ingested record is required.
Require designated MeasurementEvidence phenomenonTime.timeType INSTANT and exact /phenomenonTime/instant == subjectTime.at. No resultTime, sourceCapturedAt, recordTime or interval endpoint fallback.

The exact activity/facet, work, target, extent, performer and property/result/method/qualifier interpretation must agree; occurrence definitions apply only to this profile. Collection may use separate provenance with an unchanged ABSENT_PENDING assay, never manufacture an occurrence result.

With event absent, evaluate all same measurement and relationship predicates. With event present, independently require exact body case, Event Ingress, and fixed compatible selector from eventTime/observationTime/decisionTime/effectiveFrom equal to at; equal timestamp/family is insufficient.
Require start < end and exact endpoints equal to the designated body interval or execution payload effectiveTimeInterval. Optional payloads are not made mandatory by this branch.

Designated execution payload uses EXECUTION_INTERVAL/EFFECTIVE_INTERVAL; OBSERVED_INTERVAL requires the exact method to establish the full action interval. Omitted/UNKNOWN requires its unique versioned interpretation. Planned windows cannot prove performance.

OCCURRENCE alleges the activity over this declared interval; STARTED asserts the work start condition at start and the described interval; IN_PROGRESS asserts progress throughout the stated interval under the method; COMPLETED requires all finish conditions satisfied by end over the specified extent. An interval end alone is not completion evidence.

Event absent retains the same allegation/evidence rules. Event present requires the exact body case and both effectiveFrom == start and effectiveUntil == end, plus Event Ingress and target/extent compatibility. Missing event end cannot be invented.
Supporting interval/instant measurements may supply evidence but do not replace the designated temporal source or collapse an interval to subjectTime.at.

rowSpecializations.O10: The act is collection of the exact sample under the bound sampling procedure. STARTED is commencement of specimen collection, not ordering a test; IN_PROGRESS is actual ongoing collection/assembly of that specimen. Finish is completion of the specified specimen/support collection, independent of analysis availability.
rowSpecializations.O16: The act is communicating the exact allegation by the stated channel. STARTED is commencement of that communication, IN_PROGRESS is its ongoing transmission, COMPLETED is delivery/recording under the bound reporting procedure; none is the reported physical work.
rowSpecializations.O22: Analysis result production denotes the process for the exact analysis work, method, specimen/property and output specification. INTENDED_WINDOW uses PROSPECTIVE_OUTPUT_SPECIFICATION for every requested facet. PERFORMED OCCURRENCE, STARTED and IN_PROGRESS allow PENDING_OUTPUT without an actual result, or an explicitly evidenced ACTUAL_OUTPUT; neither proves completion. PERFORMED COMPLETED requires actual result/output evidence and all finish conditions. Both performed time profiles use this facet guard. Only PERFORMED_INSTANT selects MeasurementEvidence /phenomenonTime/instant; RESULT_TIME needs exact compatible work/facet meaning and never means the ordinary resultTime field or sample time.
rowSpecializations.O23: The act is importing/attaching the specified report into the named destination context from the identified source system. Intended window binds the intended report/selection and destination; no existing ingestion result is required. Performed interval describes this ingestion process, not the report subject or sampling/spray interval. STARTED commences the import, IN_PROGRESS means ongoing transfer/attachment, COMPLETED satisfies defined attachment/verification finish conditions. For performed instant only, RECORD_TIME describes an independently evidenced recording phenomenon selected at phenomenonTime/instant; capture/sync fields alone cannot prove it.

eventCaseRule: The exact associated case fixes family/subtype presence, dominant consequence, selected activity/facet/work/extent and time selector before evaluation. O22 analysis-result-production and O23 report-ingestion require their own case; neither borrows collection, spraying or historical pruning. Existing V04-report-ingest can support only its actual evidenced meaning. A new exact event case remains a candidate for existing-owner adoption, not admission.
qualifierRules: All five qualifiers plus omission remain available under the existing canonical activity/method semantics. OBSERVED_TIME means direct act evidence; SAMPLE_TIME collection; RESULT_TIME result production; RECORD_TIME recording; ESTIMATED_TIME explicit estimate qualification; omission only unique versioned interpretation. They are not interchangeable. Source context and result branches remain unchanged.

PROSPECTIVE_OUTPUT_SPECIFICATION.meaning: The intended output specification for this analysis work, sample, property and method. No result exists by implication, including when the requested milestone is COMPLETED.

PENDING_OUTPUT.meaning: The process is alleged to occur, start or be in progress against the exact output specification. NOT_YET_PRODUCED asserts no produced result yet; UNREPORTED asserts no result-availability fact. Neither carries an actual-result reference or supplies completion evidence.

ACTUAL_OUTPUT.meaning: An actual result is explicitly alleged and independently evidenced as output of this exact work/specification for its sample/property/method. Its existence alone does not prove STARTED, IN_PROGRESS or every finish condition.

commonPredicates: specificationBinding must equal workSpecification.outputSpecification and resolve the expected output for this exact sample, property, method and activityInstance. It is a specification binding, never a fabricated result identity.
The selected profile supplies temporal source rules independently. Actual evidence about the selected work facet is always required for performed claims; pending output does not waive that evidence.

PERFORMED COMPLETED requires ACTUAL_OUTPUT with actual result binding and independent output/provenance evidence plus every bound finish condition. PENDING_OUTPUT/PROSPECTIVE_OUTPUT_SPECIFICATION, an interval end, or a start/progress witness cannot satisfy completion.

For PERFORMED OCCURRENCE/STARTED/IN_PROGRESS, PENDING_OUTPUT is valid without an actual output. An independently existing partial/early output may instead be explicitly alleged as ACTUAL_OUTPUT, but it does not establish completion.
O22OutputContract.profilePosture: INTENDED_WINDOW requires INTENDED; PERFORMED_INSTANT/PERFORMED_INTERVAL require PERFORMED. These guards are unchanged.
